wish: someone should make an app that reminds you to cancel free trials before they end
spec:
Keeps a list of free trials sorted by days left, coloured red, amber or green as the end nears.
Type the service, start date and trial length (and price), tap Add trial; it is saved on this device.
Export reminders writes an .ics calendar file with an alert the day before each trial ends; it cannot send notifications itself or read your accounts.
notes: Offline: reminders come from the exported .ics file in your calendar app; the page cannot notify you by itself.
